diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says BLUE, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: The second reading copied the vendor PinMap table, which lists the HY2.0-4P wires from the black end ('Black Red Yellow White PORT.B GND 5V Red Btn Blue Btn'), as if it were pin 1 to 4; the M5Stack schematic J1 numbers pin 1 = A, pin 4 = GND, so pin 1 is the white wire = Blue Btn, confirmed by UiFlow2 'dual_button_0_blue , dual_button_0_red = DualButtonUnit (( 36 , 26 ))' with blue on Port B white GPIO36.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says RED, datasheet reading says 5V
diffs.evidence: The vendor PinMap 'Black Red Yellow White PORT.B GND 5V Red Btn Blue Btn' maps the yellow wire to Red Btn, and on the schematic J1 the yellow/net B wire is pin 2, so the second reading only reversed the table order (pin 2 is RED, 5V is pin 3).

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says 5V, datasheet reading says Red Btn
diffs.evidence: The vendor PinMap 'Black Red Yellow White PORT.B GND 5V Red Btn Blue Btn' puts 5V on the red wire, which is HY2.0/Grove pin 3 (schematic J1 pin 3 = VCC); the second reading listed the table reversed.

diffs.diff: header pin 4: part says GND, datasheet reading says Blue Btn
diffs.evidence: The vendor PinMap 'Black Red Yellow White PORT.B GND 5V Red Btn Blue Btn' puts GND on the black wire, HY2.0/Grove pin 4 (schematic J1 pin 4 = GND), while Blue Btn is the white wire at pin 1; the second reading listed the table reversed.
